topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Moved her desk last week, made the space look empty for a bit, like the sun sneaking behind a cloud. She was a quiet sort, had a way with people though. Gave her a nod as she headed out, saw the look in her eyes, a mix of what might be and what's left behind. Filled her in on the usual—a cup on the way to her new haunt, a word here and there, reminders of the rain we all weather. Think I might swing by that new department, see how she's settling in, make sure the move hasn't left her too far out on a limb. Kind of folks look out for each other, you know?
